title: sub-agents: a child session, not a stub
intent: The delegation API exists, the depth limit is enforced, and the child returns a string that says it is a stub. The reference harnesses give a child its own session, its own context and a restricted set of permissions, and the result comes back to the parent. This wave is that, with the restriction that a child may not spawn a child unless it is told it may.
checks: ./scripts/dev ert tests/unit/test-yeah-state.el tests/unit/test-yeah-loop.el tests/unit/test-yeah-tools.el tests/unit/test-yeah-perm.el tests/unit/test-yeah-session.el tests/unit/test-yeah-compact.el tests/unit/test-yeah-undo.el tests/unit/test-yeah-acp.el tests/unit/test-yeah-emcp.el tests/unit/test-yeah-gptel.el tests/unit/test-yeah-subagent.el tests/unit/test-yeah-shell.el tests/unit/test-yeah-codes.el
objection: A child with its own context is a second agent that can disagree, and a disagreement that nobody can see is a failure that looks like a success.
refuted_by: A child whose result reaches the parent but whose intermediate steps do not, so that the parent believes a conclusion it cannot check.
